raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Replace `github.com.evil.example` with `github.com.test.example` in the repository-link test fixture. The case continues to verify that a hostname containing `github.com` is treated as an external URL.

Validation in the PyTorch 26.09 container:

- `uv run python -m pytest --noconftest -o addopts= tests/unit_tests/doc_consistency/test_repository_links.py -q`: 36 passed.
- `uv run pre-commit run --all-files`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

Strict mypy reports the existing `no-any-return` error at line 57; the same error was reproduced on the unchanged base file.

- [test_supported_github_and_raw_urls](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/1a724b22f7f69993a3ca60e424919a874881ae2a/tests/unit_tests/doc_consistency/test_repository_links.py#L91-L108) — retain `([], [])` for supported repository URLs.
